title: ‘Devastating consequences’: One Nation plan to slash Australia’s refugee program denounced
summary_full: Amid widespread condemnation of the proposal, Pauline Hanson also wants to scrap existing parent and aged parent visa programGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcastOne Nation has vowed to cut Australia’s refugee intake by 90% and scrap the permanent parent visa program under its latest hardline plan to slash migration.Pauline Hanson announced the policy on Wednesday, labelling it a “tough” approach to migration. It was quickly criticised by political opponents and advocacy groups who labelled the announcement a “predictable and cheap” attack on refugees. Continue reading...
